# 1000-protein stratified subsample for ablation studies (agg / feature / batching)
# Drawn from the 8461-protein main_dataset.tsv pool.
# Stratified on 3 independent axes (n_heavy_atoms, plddt_mean, net_charge),
# quantile tertile bins (27 strata), proportional allocation via largest-remainder
# method with a floor of 1 per non-empty stratum, seed=42.
# sequence_length and ses_area were dropped as stratification axes: r=0.998 and
# r~0.89-0.90 with n_heavy_atoms respectively (redundant size proxies).
